dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: For a makeshift base, this is well put together. Whoever was responsible clearly knew what they were doing.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: The tents are sensibly positioned in relation to one another, and the fencing shows they were well aware that danger can approach from any direction.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: It's reassuring when you know you can rely on your companions.
